name: 🌿 自然保护区
desc: 欢迎·步道·保护规则·观鸟·野生动物·天气·防火·垃圾·向导·季节关闭

items.en: Welcome to the nature reserve.
items.zh: 欢迎来到自然保护区。

items.en: Please stay on the marked trails.
items.zh: 请走标记好的步道。

items.en: Do not pick the wild flowers.
items.zh: 不要采摘野花。

items.en: The bird tower is near the lake.
items.zh: 观鸟塔就在湖边。

items.en: Carry out all your trash.
items.zh: 把你所有的垃圾带走。

items.en: Open fires are strictly forbidden here.
items.zh: 这里严禁明火。

items.en: Guided tours start every hour.
items.zh: 导览每小时一场。

items.en: The visitor center closes at five in winter.
items.zh: 冬季游客中心五点关门。

items.en: Please keep your dog on a leash at all times.
items.zh: 请全程给你的狗系上牵引绳。

items.en: The main trail loops back to the parking lot.
items.zh: 主步道绕一圈回到停车场。

items.en: You can rent binoculars at the front gate.
items.zh: 你可以在大门口租借望远镜。

items.en: Please do not feed any of the wild animals.
items.zh: 请不要投喂任何野生动物。

items.en: Sudden storms can roll in over the mountains.
items.zh: 暴风雨可能从山那边突然袭来。

items.en: Toss your matches into the metal fire bins.
items.zh: 把火柴扔进金属防火桶里。

items.en: If you spot a deer on the path, please keep your distance and stay quiet.
items.zh: 如果你在小路上看到鹿，请保持距离并保持安静。
chunks: If you spot a deer on the path

items.en: The wetland area, which floods each spring, is closed to all visitors until May.
items.zh: 每年春天泛滥的湿地区域，五月前对所有游客关闭。

items.en: Hikers who wander off the trail can easily disturb the birds nesting in the reeds.
items.zh: 偏离步道的徒步者很容易惊扰在芦苇丛中筑巢的鸟。
chunks: Hikers who wander off the trail
the birds nesting in the reeds

items.en: Because the ground is dry, we ask that no one light a fire.
items.zh: 由于地面干燥，我们请求任何人都不要生火。

items.en: When the north trail is icy, our guides will lead you along the river instead.
items.zh: 当北步道结冰时，向导会改带你沿河而行。
chunks: When the north trail is icy

items.en: The green bins that sit along the path are meant only for recyclable bottles and cans.
items.zh: 沿路摆放的绿色垃圾桶只用于可回收的瓶子和易拉罐。
chunks: The green bins that sit along the path

items.en: If a bear approaches, back away slowly and do not turn to run.
items.zh: 如果熊靠近，请慢慢后退，不要转身逃跑。
chunks: and do not turn to run
